title: Kernel vanishing for the descended inclusion by monicity
statement: theorem coherentFormalModule_kernel_quotient_inclusion_bound {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) (F : CoherentFormalModule X I) (S : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ X.Modules) (j : S ⟶ F.obj) (hj : ∀ m : ℕ, Mono (j.app (op m))) (d n : ℕ) : kernel.ι ((formalShiftedQuotientι I F S j d).app (op (n + d))) ≫ (formalShiftedQuotient I S d).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_add_right n d)).op = 0

proof.text: If all j_m are monic, cancel j_(n+d) in the ideal-product vanishing equation to descend S_(n+2d) to S_(n+d) through the quotient at n+d. Denote the descended map by k. Cancel its quotient projection to identify the inclusion at n+d with k followed by j_(n+d), and the transition to level n with k followed by the quotient projection of S_(n+d). Cancel the monomorphism j_(n+d) in the kernel condition: the kernel arrow kills k, and therefore kills that transition.
